title: Architecture Site
summary: Explains a system from its own repository — components, flows, and contracts — for a team that needs to work in it.

page_types.purpose: Give a reader (live or async) a one-screen kickoff: what this artifact is, who should read which page, and how to ask questions.
Answer what this system is and does, in a few sentences, before any detail.
Show the system's major components and how they relate, before drilling into any one.
Introduce each major component: its responsibility, its interfaces, and what depends on it.
Show real, generator-sourced examples of the system's actual inputs and outputs.
Walk one real request or event through the system end to end.
Compare components or approaches cell by cell (for example, capability × component).
Trace a control or data flow across several components in sequence.
Document the data shapes and contracts the system relies on.
Summarize what tests cover the system and what CI checks on every change.
Auto-built from contents.json's terms[] — every defined term in one place. Not hand-authored.
